in_scope.instructions:
Worklytics is concerned about any vulnerabilties in web applications hosted under any sub-domain of worklytics.co.  Specifically, we host our marketing site at www.worklytics.co, and our web application platform at app.worklytics.co, app-eu.worklytics.co (EU customers), and intl.worklytics.co (non-EU markets).  

Due to the nature of our business, secure handling of data is our primary concern. Exploits that could expose customer data in a manner inconsistent with the working of our application is our primary concern.
